title: The finite-cutoff beta=1 Wick quartic has an exact nonnegative square completion after a vacuum shift

square_completion.cutoff_variance: At every finite beta=1 cutoff N, C_N=sum_k (2 omega_k)^(-1) is finite
square_completion.vacuum_shift: On normalized T^3, adding 6 C_N^2 to the integrated Wick quartic gives integral (phi_N^2-3C_N)^2 dx, which is nonnegative
square_completion.sector_consequence: The shifted multiplication form is semibounded on every particle sector at fixed cutoff; K1459 excludes free-form domination, not this nonlinear-domain route
square_completion.counterterm_accounting: The additional term is a scalar cutoff-dependent vacuum-energy counterterm and must be retained explicitly
square_completion.ceiling: Square completion alone proves no ultraviolet convergence, bounded free-vacuum energy, nontrivial continuum interaction, source ownership or interacting BRST closure
